faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Does my child need prior coding experience?
faq.a1: Not at all! The course starts from absolute zero with child-friendly fun explanations.
faq.q2: What age group is this course for?
faq.a2: Specially designed for children aged 6 to 14.
faq.q3: Can we try a lesson before subscribing?
faq.a3: Yes! Lesson 1 is completely free to try right away.
faq.a4: HD video lessons with embedded Scratch environment, quizzes, and teacher feedback.
